name: Ichizu ni Zettai Fukujuu na Imouto o Mechakucha ni Shitemita ~Aiyoku Kyoudai~
original_name: 一途に絶対服従な妹をめちゃくちゃにしてみた ～愛欲兄妹～
source:

...But something was missing...

--My feet automatically led me to the bathroom where my sister was.

Ignoring her screams, I closed the bathroom door behind me.
Then, as if trying to shake off the indescribable frustration and guilt I felt about what I was about to do, I exposed my erection.
